question: Two years ago, the population of a small town was 60,000. It increased by 5% in the first year, but due to the pandemic, it decreased by 10% in the second year. What is its present population (after the end of 2 years)?
solution:
**Given:**

Two years ago, the population of a small town was 60,000. It increased by 5% in the first year, but due to the pandemic, it decreased by 10% in the second year.

**Calculation:**

After the first year the population will be,

⇒ 60000 × 105 /100 = 63000

After the second year the population will be ,

⇒ 63000 × 90/100 = 56,700
